title: Microcredentials for Open Hardware and HPC Workforce Development: The Openchip Approach with RISC-V Ecosystem
problem: Skills gap in HPC and semiconductor sectors; traditional academic programs cannot keep pace with rapid technological evolution in open hardware
motivation: EU Chips Act and national sovereignty initiatives demand workforce development; open platforms like RISC-V require new educational approaches
method: Microcredential-based modular training; co-designed curricula focusing on vector RISC-V architectures and full-stack HPC system design
key_novelty: Agile, scalable microcredential framework aligned with TCPP curriculum for open hardware education
contributions: Proposes microcredential strategy for HPC workforce development
Analyzes curricular gaps in open hardware training
Provides roadmap for embedding microcredentials in sovereign HPC ecosystems
limitations: Abstractly focuses on curriculum design without empirical validation of outcomes
